verdict.rationale: Stripe's Payment Links docs say you can create a payment link and share it on social media, in emails, or on your website. The Tax docs confirm payment-link pages can collect tax without writing any code, and links support local languages, currencies and payment methods. missing for 10: explicit documentation that links are created in the Dashboard UI, evidence of how quickly a new account can start selling, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-code flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Create a payment link and share it on social media, in emails, or on your website.
Collect tax on Payment Links: Learn how to calculate and collect tax on a payment page without writing any code.
Let your customers use a link to pay in their local language and currency with their preferred payment method.
